question: How are NYC crashes distributed across the days of the week, 2013 to 2025?

initial_plan.answerability: yes: crash_date supports assigning each recorded crash to a weekday; the metric adjusts counts for the number of calendar dates of each weekday in the observed date span
initial_plan.metric: mean number of crash records per calendar occurrence of each weekday
initial_plan.denominator: number of calendar dates of that weekday from the earliest through latest non-missing crash_date in 2013–2025, inclusive
initial_plan.population: police-reported crash records with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
initial_plan.grouping: weekday of crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check_interpretation.facts: The selected population contains 2,132,218 crash records across 2013–2025. Every year has calendar bounds from January 1 through December 31. Within the selected rows crash_date is missing 0 times; impossible dates are 0, and the checked sentinel dates 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01 and 2000-01-01 each occur 0 times. Counts per year are in check_2.csv.
data_check_interpretation.row_decisions: Keep all in-range rows; no in-range rows are removed or separated by date quality. Rows with NULL or out-of-range crash_date cannot be assigned to this period or weekday and are not measured by the scoped check, so their number is not asserted.
data_check_interpretation.plan_changes: None. Complete year bounds mean the observed weekday exposure covers full calendar years, so the denominator will count calendar dates of each weekday in the full date span; the check establishes bounds, not completeness of reporting on every individual date.

final_plan.answerability: yes: date-grouped crash records and calendar-day exposure support an average recorded crash count per occurrence of each weekday
final_plan.metric: mean number of police-reported crash records per calendar occurrence of each weekday
final_plan.denominator: number of calendar dates of each weekday from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive
final_plan.population: all records with crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive (2,132,218 records in the checked population)
final_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive; each year has observed date bounds Jan 1–Dec 31
final_plan.grouping: weekday of crash_date in Monday-to-Sunday order
final_plan.limitations: This is an average per calendar weekday date, not a rate per travel exposure or a measure of crash risk; it combines all years. Complete Jan 1–Dec 31 bounds were found each year, but the check does not prove each date is equally covered. Records with missing or out-of-period dates are not assignable to the defined population; their number was not assessed by the in-population check.
